candidates.summary: Said he was home all evening, later said he went out briefly for groceries.

a.quote: I was at home all evening.
a.subject: whereabouts on November 3rd evening

b.quote: I think I went out briefly to get some groceries, maybe around 7:30, but came right back.
b.subject: whereabouts on November 3rd evening

candidates.note: Being home all evening conflicts with leaving the home to go to a store.

candidates.summary: Bedtime moved from about 10-10:30pm to around midnight.
candidates.note: Same event, but the stated bedtime differs by about 1.5 to 2 hours.

candidates.summary: Said he was alone, later mentioned possibly waving at a neighbor in the parking lot.

b.quote: My neighbor, Tom, might have seen me. We waved or something in the parking lot.
b.subject: contact with neighbor Tom

candidates.note: Waving is not clearly speaking to someone, and the statement is hedged, but it adds a new person to the evening.

candidates.summary: Denied ever knowing the Hargrove Street location, later admitted driving through the area.

a.quote: No, never. I don't even know where that is.
a.subject: Hargrove Street warehouse

b.quote: I mean, I've driven through that part of town.
b.subject: Hargrove Street area

candidates.note: Not knowing where it is conflicts with having driven through the area, though the warehouse and the area are not identical.

candidates.summary: Said he had never heard of Daniel Cho, later said he knew of him through mutual friends.

a.quote: No. I'd never heard of him before this whole thing started.
a.subject: Daniel Cho

b.quote: I knew of him. We had mutual friends.
b.subject: Daniel Cho

candidates.note: Never having heard of him conflicts with knowing of him through mutual friends.

candidates.summary: Mentioned pizza and TV earlier, later uncertain and added groceries.

a.quote: I ordered pizza around 7pm and watched TV.
a.subject: evening activities

b.quote: I might have done both. I don't remember exactly, it was almost a year ago.
b.subject: evening activities

candidates.note: The witness says both could have happened, so this is a hedge rather than a clear contradiction.
